description: This Java source file defines the EnterpriseApplication class that sets up and boots an embedded Jetty server, deploying a web application based on configuration and resources loaded from the classpath.

classes.name: EnterpriseApplication
classes.description: Main class responsible for bootstrapping and running an embedded Jetty server with a web application.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that initializes and starts the Jetty server, setting up web application context and shutdown hooks.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Resolves a resource path to an absolute filesystem path, used to locate webapp resources.

methods.name: resolvePort
methods.description: Determines the port to run the server on based on system properties, defaulting to 8090.
